mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5%, labor market tightness fuels wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between INDPRO and HOUST signals a supply-side imbalance when INDPRO growth outpaces HOUST by > 2pp in 2 months, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and HOUST growth differentials remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% MoM signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite strong retail sales growth.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth above 3% YoY, combined with FEDFUNDS above 4%, indicates inflationary pressures and tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth trend (3-month moving average) predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with positive PAYEMS growth indicating positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a GDPC1 quarterly growth rebound to above 1% YoY signals renewed economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 1% in post-shock recovery
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered post-shock instances despite GDP growth rebound.
